title: fix(spec)!: composeStacks judges the objects a nested artifact's package bodies declare, refusing the pair install refuses under every objectConflict strategy (ADR-0150 D4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgJSRdLSMks47MshHcmtLwgx)_
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CXcWzBCdaWZrrdKNDw

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`composeStacks` 的对象合并步骤现在也读「嵌套产物」（自带 `packages[]` 的输入，例如 preserve 组合出的多包产物）里每个包体声明的对象；某个包体里的对象名若另一个输入也声明了，就拒绝，`objectConflict` 取 error、override、merge 都一样。
- 为什么改：多包产物只在包体里带对象，旧检查只看顶层，所以「嵌套产物 + 另一个声明同名对象的包」在所有模式下都被放行。放行后启动的结果：preserve 下启动报 DUPLICATE_ARTIFACT_OBJECT_NAME；默认 manifest 下只留 p1 的对象，另一个包的字段和动作被静默丢掉。逐个安装同样几个包时，后一个会被拒。
- 风险与回滚：只收窄（BREAKING）：原本放行的上述组合改为 422 STACK_COMPOSE_OBJECT_CONFLICT；不带 `packages[]` 的输入判法逐字节不变，合成输出形状不变；第一方普查 0。只改 spec 一个文件的私有函数，runtime 不动；回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` 新增的 `refuseNestedBodyObjectConflicts`（约 7770 行）及其在 `mergeObjects` 末尾的调用（约 7719 行）；`compose-stacks.test.ts` 末尾新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/compose-stacks.test.ts`，预期 58/58 通过（契约审查补丁轮 `bb7403dc` 后）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #32477

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — `composeStacks` refuses, `422 STACK_COMPOSE_OBJECT_CONFLICT`, a composition it admitted before: an input that already carries `packages[]` (a nested artifact) whose package body declares an object name another input also declares, under `objectConflict: 'error'`, `'override'` and `'merge'` alike and under either manifest. Nothing is widened.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` names `composeStacks` only as an existence pointer (`skills/objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md`) and teaches no object-conflict rule; the prescription ships in the refusal text.

## What changes

`mergeObjects` (`composeStacks` step 2, `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`) walked each input's top-level `objects` only. A multi-package artifact composed under `manifest: 'preserve'` strips its flattened copy and carries its objects only in `packages[]` bodies, so composing it again beside another input that declares one of its bodies' object names saw one declaration and admitted the pair, under every strategy. The boot registers every body, and installing the packages one by one refuses the second claim on the name, so compose was the one door that did not.

- **Reads the bodies, judges only.** A new private helper, `refuseNestedBodyObjectConflicts`, runs at the end of `mergeObjects`. For every input carrying `packages[]`, each body (`entry.manifest`) contributes the objects its input's own top level does not carry (the top level claims a name over its bodies, as `resolveArtifactCollections` in `@objectstack/runtime` reads it), noted at `packages[K].objects['NAME']` with the body as holder (`id || name`, and its namespace, both named in the issue). A name declared by two inputs, either declaration a body's, is refused with `StackComposeObjectConflictError` (`422 STACK_COMPOSE_OBJECT_CONFLICT`), one issue per name naming every declaring input and site. Body objects are never lifted into the composed list, so the output shape does not change.
- **Every strategy (seat ruling on step 0, option A; Claim amendment 6810557307).** Composition carries a nested input's bodies as they are, so `'override'` cannot replace a declaration inside one and `'merge'` cannot fold it; measured, both left the body's object to the boot exactly as `'error'` did. The refusal message says so and names the remedies: rename one object, or contribute through `objectExtensions`; and, for flat inputs under the default manifest only, compose them with `'override'` / `'merge'`, which fold the two into one object. Under `{ manifest: 'preserve' }` each package keeps its own body, so there only the first two remedies apply (contract review 6811982973 S1). Two nested artifacts whose bodies share a name, and the same holder on both sides, are refused the same way.
- **Embedded actions.** An action both sides embed on that object is now refused here, at step 2, before step 6 (`collectComposedActionKeyCollisions`) — so step 6's skip of a body object (#32335) rests on a true premise. Step 6 is unchanged.
- **Strictly narrowing.** The helper only throws; it adds no admission. Inputs with no `packages[]` contribute nothing beyond what the existing walk already refuses, and the existing walk runs first, so a flat composition is judged byte for byte as before (including its refusal text).
- **No contract shape moves.** No authorable key, schema shape or `api-surface` export (one private interface and one private helper). Runtime unchanged.

### Before / after (A = `p1` (namespace alpha, declares `alpha_shared`) + `p2` (beta), composed under `'preserve'`; `q` = namespace alpha, depends on p1, declares `alpha_shared`)

Object names carry their package's namespace prefix, so a reachable shared-name pair is always a same-namespace co-owner pair.

| case (A+q and q+A alike) | before (#32475 head 8be0f346) | after |
|---|---|---|
| flat `p1` + `q`, `'error'`, either manifest | REFUSED `422 STACK_COMPOSE_OBJECT_CONFLICT`, issue `object 'alpha_shared' is defined in multiple stacks.` | unchanged (CONTROL) |
| flat `p1` + `q`, `'override'` / `'merge'` | composed (merge + differing embedded `approve`: `STACK_COMPOSE_COLLECTION_CONFLICT`) | unchanged (CONTROL) |
| A + `q`, `'error'`, `'preserve'` | ACCEPTED, packages `[p1, p2, q]`; the boot refuses `DUPLICATE_ARTIFACT_OBJECT_NAME 422` | REFUSED `422 STACK_COMPOSE_OBJECT_CONFLICT`, issue `… 'com.example.p2' (stack #0) at packages[0].objects['alpha_shared'] (package 'com.example.p1', namespace 'alpha') and 'com.example.q' (stack #1) at stack.objects[0].` |
| A + `q`, `'error'`, default manifest | ACCEPTED; the boot serves p1's object, q's fields and actions silently gone | REFUSED, same code and issue |
| A + `q`, `'override'` / `'merge'`, `'preserve'` | ACCEPTED; the boot refuses `DUPLICATE_ARTIFACT_OBJECT_NAME 422` | REFUSED, same code and issue |
| A + `q`, `'override'` / `'merge'`, default manifest | ACCEPTED; the boot serves p1's object (override overrode nothing, merge merged nothing) | REFUSED, same code and issue |
| approve = true (both sides embed `approve` on the object), each row above | same verdicts; the embedded pair admitted by step 6 | REFUSED at the object door, same issue |
| A + B (B = `q` + `p3` under `'preserve'`): two nested artifacts | ACCEPTED (measured by the ablation below) | REFUSED, issue naming both bodies |
| A + `r` (namespace gamma, another object), either manifest | ACCEPTED | ACCEPTED (CONTROL), output unchanged |
| install `p1`, `p2`, `q` one by one | `q` REFUSED `DUPLICATE_ARTIFACT_OBJECT_NAME 422` | (runtime, unchanged) |

(The stack label of A is `'com.example.p2'`: A takes its last input's manifest.)

### Census

`git grep -n "composeStacks(" -- examples packages ':!*.test.ts'` → one call, `examples/app-multi-package/objectstack.config.ts:68`, composing two flat stacks (no `packages[]` input). First-party affected: **0**. The spec suite (every compose fixture) passes unchanged.

## Tests

`packages/spec/src/compose-stacks.test.ts`, one new top-level `describe` in the existing harness (13 cases; 11 at the ablated head, plus 2 from the contract-review patch round: the same holder on both sides, refused; and a CONTROL that an additive artifact claiming the name at its top level is judged by the existing walk with `main`'s issue): the nested input's shape; nested + flat refused under each of `'error'` / `'override'` / `'merge'` × `'preserve'` / default manifest, in both orders (`code` + `status` + the exact `issues` path); the embedded-`approve` pair refused at the object door; nested + nested refused; CONTROL flat pair judged as before (refused with its own issue under `'error'`, reconciled under `'override'`); CONTROL nested artifact beside a different object composes with its output unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- Two bodies inside ONE nested input that declare the same name are that input's own composition's business and are not re-judged here (the first body per name stands for the input).

## Verification

Record at head 9241122bac (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`), after merging `origin/main` with #32475 (6ff08b036) on it.

<details><summary>Step 0 measurement (before)</summary>

A temporary rig (not committed) under `packages/runtime/src/domains/`, run on the built `@objectstack/runtime` closure at 8be0f346 under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (`VERDICT command-exit 0`, Tests 2/2), booting each composed artifact through `MetadataPlugin` + `ObjectQLPlugin` + `AppPlugin` on SQLite:

```
FLAT p1+q error (either manifest)          : REFUSED StackComposeObjectConflictError STACK_COMPOSE_OBJECT_CONFLICT 422
NESTED A+q / q+A, error|override|merge, preserve : COMPOSED packages [p1,p2,q] -> BOOT REFUSED ArtifactObjectNameConflictError DUPLICATE_ARTIFACT_OBJECT_NAME 422
NESTED A+q / q+A, error|override|merge, default  : COMPOSED packages [p1,p2], top.objects [alpha_shared from q]
                                                   -> BOOTED label 'from p1', owner com.qa.o.p1, fields [only_p1], actions [approve=approve p1]
CONTROL A + r (other object), preserve     : COMPOSED
install p1, p2, q one by one               : p1 admitted, p2 admitted, q REFUSED DUPLICATE_ARTIFACT_OBJECT_NAME 422
```
</details>

<details><summary>Tests and ablation</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/compose-stacks.test.ts`: Tests 56 passed (56).
- Ablation (one, `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): anchor `  refuseNestedBodyObjectConflicts(stacks);` (the call at the end of `mergeObjects`) replaced by `  /* ABLATION_32477_NO_BODY_DOOR */ void 0;` (mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, marker 0 -> 1, grep-confirmed). Result on `-t 'nested artifact'`: 8 failed / 3 passed — every refusal pin went red (the six mode × manifest pins, the embedded-`approve` pin and the nested + nested pin; each composed, `[undefined, undefined]` for code/status), and the shape pin and both CONTROLs stayed green. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. A first attempt used a replacement that referenced an undefined identifier and threw everywhere (11/11 red, CONTROLs included); it is discarded as not a valid ablation and was re-run as above. spec tests import `./stack.zod` from source, so no `dist/` leg applies.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 836 passed (836), Tests 26707 passed, 1 todo. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0. Lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Full dogfood (title carries `!`): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` on the built closure under `os-verify-lock.sh`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, Test Files 451 passed, 3 skipped (454), Tests 3775 passed, 42 skipped (3817).
</details>
